Validation of a pod spec will always use the pod's TerminationGracePeriodSeconds value.

A set of pod test-helpers have been created to help construct Pods.

issue_context.title: Cleanup: Validate pod terminationGracePeriodSeconds and fix tests
issue_context.body:
xref: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/119026/files#r1265687485

Apparently we do not validate that the `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` field is non-nil.  It has a default value, so it should never actually be nil, but because we never validated it in the past, we have tests that do not set it.

We should remove code which check for nil, like the above comment:

```
	var gracePeriod int64
	if spec.TerminationGracePeriodSeconds != nil {
		// this could happen in tests
		gracePeriod = *spec.TerminationGracePeriodSeconds
	}
```

This will cause a bunch of tests to fail.  Those tests SHOULD be setting this field properly.  See "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/api/service/testing" which has helper functions for the same problem in Service.
